descriptions.zh: 初步扫描显示，一系列高耸发光结构耸立于一片平凡的地貌。其起源和用途仍不明确，但其幽光说示这不仅仅是自然现象。
descriptions.en: Initial scans reveal a series of towering, luminescent structures rising from an otherwise unremarkable landscape. Their origin and purpose remain unclear, but their spectral glow suggests something more than a natural phenomenon.

sections.zh: 初步扫描显示，一系列高耸发光结构耸立于一片平凡的地貌。其起源和用途仍不明确，但其幽光说示这不仅仅是自然现象。
sections.en: Initial scans reveal a series of towering, luminescent structures rising from an otherwise unremarkable landscape. Their origin and purpose remain unclear, but their spectral glow suggests something more than a natural phenomenon.

descriptions.zh: 令人震惊的§Y[from.GetName]§!图像显示，一颗燃烧熔融星球上突然出现一片大陆大小的明亮绿色地带。这一罕见景象表明其地表存在极其异常的情况。
descriptions.en: Startling images of §Y[from.GetName]§! show a burning, molten world interrupted by a startlingly bright, continent-sized swathe of green. This exceptional sight suggests something highly unusual on the surface.

sections.zh: 令人震惊的§Y[from.GetName]§!图像显示，一颗燃烧熔融星球上突然出现一片大陆大小的明亮绿色地带。这一罕见景象表明其地表存在极其异常的情况。
sections.en: Startling images of §Y[from.GetName]§! show a burning, molten world interrupted by a startlingly bright, continent-sized swathe of green. This exceptional sight suggests something highly unusual on the surface.

descriptions.zh: 对[Planet.GetName]的例行扫描发现大气中存在异常强烈的化学波动。深入调查或能揭示真相。
descriptions.en: A routine scan of [Planet.GetName] noted unusually strong chemical fluctuations in the atmosphere. A closer survey may explain what is happening here.

sections.zh: 对[Planet.GetName]的例行扫描发现大气中存在异常强烈的化学波动。深入调查或能揭示真相。
sections.en: A routine scan of [Planet.GetName] noted unusually strong chemical fluctuations in the atmosphere. A closer survey may explain what is happening here.

descriptions.zh: 该行星表面似有大片自由流动的熔岩池，或具备资源开采潜力，值得深入调查。
descriptions.en: This planet appears to have large pools of free-flowing lava on its surface. These are worth investigating, in case they present opportunities for resource harvesting.

sections.zh: 该行星表面似有大片自由流动的熔岩池，或具备资源开采潜力，值得深入调查。
sections.en: This planet appears to have large pools of free-flowing lava on its surface. These are worth investigating, in case they present opportunities for resource harvesting.

descriptions.zh: [Planet.GetName]看似典型的火山荒原，但氧气含量却异常之高，一定是有特殊生物在产生氧气。
descriptions.en: While [Planet.GetName] appears to be a typical volcanic wasteland, the oxygen content is strangely high. Something unusual must be producing that oxygen.

sections.zh: [Planet.GetName]看似典型的火山荒原，但氧气含量却异常之高，一定是有特殊生物在产生氧气。

descriptions.zh: 在[Planet.GetName]的风化层中发现异常低温现象，某种过程或物体可能正在导致地表部分区域降温。钻探勘测将揭示更多信息。
descriptions.en: Strange low-temperature anomalies were detected in the regolith of [Planet.GetName], suggesting that some process or object may be cooling parts of the surface. A drilling expedition would reveal more.

sections.zh: 在[Planet.GetName]的风化层中发现异常低温现象，某种过程或物体可能正在导致地表部分区域降温。钻探勘测将揭示更多信息。
sections.en: Strange low-temperature anomalies were detected in the regolith of [Planet.GetName], suggesting that some process or object may be cooling parts of the surface. A drilling expedition would reveal more.

descriptions.zh: 对[Planet.GetName]的首次勘测发现，行星的主熔岩海洋中存在一种奇特的风暴状形态，极为罕见，值得深入研调查。
descriptions.en: The first survey of [Planet.GetName] revealed a strange storm-like shape in the planet's main lava ocean. This phenomenon is highly unusual, and bears investigating.

sections.zh: 对[Planet.GetName]的首次勘测发现，行星的主熔岩海洋中存在一种奇特的风暴状形态，极为罕见，值得深入研调查。

descriptions.zh: 科学家在[Planet.GetName]某一地点捕捉到规律性的电波峰，似与信号源从夜到昼的交替时间同步。
descriptions.en: Our scientists have detected regular radio wave spikes from a single point on [Planet.GetName]. They appear to coincide with the time at which the source of the signal crosses from night into day.

sections.zh: 科学家在[Planet.GetName]某一地点捕捉到规律性的电波峰，似与信号源从夜到昼的交替时间同步。
sections.en: Our scientists have detected regular radio wave spikes from a single point on [Planet.GetName]. They appear to coincide with the time at which the source of the signal crosses from night into day.

descriptions.zh: 探测器发现一奇异物体在小行星带中漂移。其来源未知，但轨迹稳定，表明可拦截检查。
descriptions.en: Sensors have picked up a strange object drifting through the asteroid field. Its origin is unknown, but its course is steady, suggesting it can be intercepted and examined.

descriptions.zh: 这些坐标位置上的行星据说藏有大量休眠者和技术，我们应该展开彻底调查。
descriptions.en: The planet at these coordinates is supposed to hide a cache of sleepers and technology. We should investigate thoroughly.
